北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京今天晴好，但体感仅 -5℃，记得多穿暖和点，别冻着了哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is sunny, but feels like -5°C. Remember to dress warmly and stay cozy!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云，体感 4℃ 有点凉。出门别忘添衣，注意保暖哈！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a real feel of 4°C. Don't forget to add layers and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感 4℃，微风有些凉。记得带件外套，别感冒了呀。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with a real feel of 4°C and a slight chill. Bring a jacket to avoid catching a cold.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 21℃ 暖洋洋。尽情享受这舒适的好天气吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and warm at 21°C. Enjoy this lovely weather to the fullest!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴空万里，气温 20℃，体感舒适。很适合户外活动哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is clear and 20°C, feeling very pleasant. Perfect for outdoor activities!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 3℃ 略有寒意。早晚温差大，注意及时添衣哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with a real feel of 3°C, a bit chilly. Mind the temperature difference and dress accordingly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，体感 3℃，风力 2级。出门记得多穿点，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like 3°C with a 2-level breeze. Remember to dress warmly and protect against the wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 11℃，体感 9℃。微凉，带件薄外套出门更舒适。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 11°C, feels like 9°C. A bit cool, a light jacket would be comfortable.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，体感 7℃，略显湿冷。记得多穿一层，暖暖和和过一天。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 7°C, a bit damp and cold. Remember to add a layer to stay warm all day.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 3℃ 较干燥。记得多喝水，做好保湿防寒准备哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 3°C and quite dry. Remember to hydrate and stay moisturized while keeping warm.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 10℃ 湿度高。出门备伞，注意防潮防湿，别着凉。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy, feels like 10°C with high humidity. Bring an umbrella, protect from dampness, and don't catch a cold.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，但体感低至 -23℃！帽子手套围巾，全副武装再出门。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is clear, but feels as cold as -23°C! Hats, gloves, scarves – bundle up before heading out.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴好，体感 -16℃ 寒意浓。多穿厚衣，小心保暖，注意防滑。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear, feels like -16°C and very cold. Wear thick clothes, stay warm, and watch out for slippery surfaces.
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光明媚，气温 20℃，体感 17℃。气候宜人，记得补水哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and bright, 20°C, feels like 17°C. Pleasant weather, but remember to hydrate.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 8℃，风力 3级。海风较大，外出记得添件外套。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy, feels like 8°C with a level 3 wind. The sea breeze is strong, remember to bring a jacket.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -2℃ 伴随海风。多穿点，暖身又防风，注意保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, feels like -2°C with a sea breeze. Dress warmly to stay cozy and protect from the wind.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -8℃。寒风料峭，出门请务必做好头部和手部保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, feels like -8°C. The wind is chilly, make sure to keep your head and hands warm when going out.
